subject: science
title: Unit 2: Protecting Ears & Muffling Sound
subTitle: Ear defenders, silencers and sound insulation

cards.vietnamese: Tai nghe bảo vệ chống ồn: Dụng cụ đệm bảo vệ tai khỏi tiếng ồn nguy hiểm
cards.definition: Padded protection worn over the ears to protect hearing against very loud sounds.
cards.example: Airport ground staff wear ear defenders to protect their hearing from jet engines.

cards.vietnamese: Bộ giảm thanh / Ống pô giảm tiếng ồn lắp trên xe máy, ô tô
cards.definition: Equipment fitted to an exhaust pipe to make engine sounds quieter.
cards.example: Motorbikes have silencers to reduce exhaust noise.

cards.vietnamese: Làm nghẹt, làm giảm âm lượng và độ vang của âm thanh
cards.definition: To decrease the volume and clarity of a sound by covering or insulating.
cards.example: Putting a cushion over a ringing alarm clock will muffle the sound.

exercises.question: What protective equipment do workers wear around loud airplane engines?
exercises.explanation: Tai nghe giảm ồn (ear defenders) bảo vệ màng nhĩ khỏi âm thanh quá lớn.

exercises.question: What is fitted to motorbike exhausts to reduce loud engine noise?
exercises.explanation: Silencers (bộ giảm thanh) làm giảm tiếng nổ phát ra từ động cơ.

exercises.question: What does 'muffle' a sound mean?
options: To make it quieter and less clear
exercises.explanation: Muffle nghĩa là làm dịu bớt, làm nghẹt âm thanh bằng vật cản/tiêu âm.
